packageRules.description: Keep @types/node on the 22.13.x patch line so it never runs ahead of engines.node's floor (>=22.13.0). A types package ahead of the runtime floor lets tsc silently accept Node APIs that don't exist at runtime on the floor. This is a silent, permanent block with no expiry: when engines.node's floor moves to a new minor line, update allowedVersions here to match, or Renovate will keep quietly rejecting every @types/node update.
